title: Verdicts on guessed or sizeless items can still be stronger than the evidence (sweep items A6 to A11 of D-270 never fixed)
evidence: DEFECTS D-270 state: 'Still open: A6 to A11 in the sweep doc'. Code check today: app/src/distribution.ts:61-65 askClaude returns only lowCents/highCents/currency, so the Claude range's `unit` and `confidence` (range-ask.ts) are dropped before price/src/estimate.ts:1519 sets basis 'claude_typical' (A7); poolPoints(..., null, false) at estimate.ts category_prior mixes sizes (A6); verdict-chart.js multipleOf() prints 'Nx the typical price' beside a Bad word with no guard on a wide or AI bell (A8). A9 to A11 (sale-only items judged as regular, other_region note rarely fires, biggerPack note any store any age) read from the sweep doc, not re-run. Live wrongness of these paths was not measured here; the 11-14 accuracy gate (docs/decisions.md 3090) measures typed-name product identity, not these.
fix: Pass unit and confidence through askClaude and refuse a shelf-price verdict (range card only) when unit is per-kg or per-bottle or size is unknown, as the range-only sheet already does (catalogue-range.js:90); suppress the 'Nx' text when the bell is AI or wider than 2.25x.
fix_cost: half a day, Jamin's price engine, no money
dup_of: none (D-270 is on no list; gap 47 and R23 cover coverage and poisoned prices, not this)

title: Typed search ranking and size handling still weak: a bare generic word tops a flavoured snack and a size in the query is ignored
evidence: D-269 state: 'Abbreviations, sizes in the query and ranking ... still open'. Live probes 2026-11-21 (probe-review-old-lists, 4 GETs to /api/search): q=ketchup returned Doritos Ketchup 80g first, then Ketchup, Ketchup 750ml, Heinz Ketchup 2.84l (band ambiguous); q='heinz ketchup 750 ml' returned the 1.25 L first and no 750 ml row; q='cheerios 500g' returned 570 g first; q=oj returned 'OJ Cheonggukjang 330G'. The band says ambiguous so the shopper can pick, which limits the harm; D-269 is not on any list.
fix: Boost rows whose size matches a size typed in the query and whose name equals the query; add a small abbreviation list (oj, pb, kd).
fix_cost: half a day, Jamin's search route
